message.reasoning: The user wants to start Docker on Windows using docker start. They likely want to run a command to start Docker service. On Windows, Docker Desktop runs as a service. The command to start Docker Desktop is "docker start" but that's for containers. To start Docker service, you can use "net start com.docker.service" or "Start-Service -Name com.docker.service" in PowerShell. But the user says "using docker start". That might be ambiguous. They might want to start Docker Desktop via command line. The typical command is "docker start" for containers. But to start Docker Desktop, you can use "docker start" only if Docker Desktop is already running. Actually, Docker Desktop is a service that runs automatically. If it's stopped, you can start it via "net start com.docker.service". Or "Start-Service -Name com.docker.service". So we need to provide a command to start Docker service. The user says "start Docker on window using docker start." That might be a mistake. We can respond with a command: "net start com.docker.service" or "Start-Service -Name com.docker.service". Let's provide both options. Also mention that "docker start" is for containers. So we can give a command to start Docker Desktop service. We'll use the function to execute the command.
